name: social-2: the party size ladder the other way (the pair held, the three x1.10, the four x1.20)
why: 57-review-social R3 after social-1 regressed P6. P6 (ruled 10-25) reads a party a head against a lone hero on the SAME tier and wants it to rise with size: 1.05 to 1.15, 1.10 to 1.20, 1.15 to 1.25. The pair is in band on Deadly and the three and four are under. This raises every three cell by 1.10 and every four cell by 1.20. It targets P6. P7 (the party against the pace contract) is expected to move away: that is the conflict this patch measures.
